import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] e;
    static int[] matchL, matchR;
    static boolean[] used;
    static int sp, pp;
    static int n, t;
    static int[][] ir, sc, pc;
    static char[][] s, p;
    static int[][] dd;
    static int[] dx = {0,1,-1,0};
    static int[] dy = {1,0,0,-1};
    static ArrayList<Integer>[][] ns, np;

    static void ade(int a, int b) {
        e[a].add(b);
        e[b].add(a);
    }

    static boolean dfsKuhn(int u) {
        for (int v : e[u]) {
            if (!used[v]) {
            used[v] = true;
            if (matchR[v] == 0 || dfsKuhn(matchR[v])) {
                matchL[u] = v;
                matchR[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
            }
        }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int kuhn() {
        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < sp; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(used, false);
            if (matchL[i] == 0 && dfsKuhn(i))
                ++res;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void wk(int a, int b) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                dd[i][j] = 100000;
        Deque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        dd[a][b] = 0;
        q.addLast(new int[]{a,b});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.pollFirst();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int police : np[x][y])
                for (int surv : ns[a][b])
                    ade(surv, police);
            if (dd[x][y] == ir[x][y]) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n && sc[nx][ny] != -1 && dd[nx][ny] > dd[x][y] + 1 && dd[x][y] + 1 <= ir[nx][ny]) {
                    dd[nx][ny] = dd[x][y] + 1;
                    q.addLast(new int[]{nx,ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        // initialize arrays
        e = new ArrayList[2020];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2020; ++i) e[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        matchL = new int[2020];
        matchR = new int[2020];
        used = new boolean[2020];
        sp = 1;
        pp = 1000;
        ir = new int[21][21];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                ir[i][j] = t;
        s = new char[21][21];
        p = new char[21][21];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                s[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                p[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
        }
        sc = new int[21][21];
        pc = new int[21][21];
        ns = new ArrayList[21][21];
        np = new ArrayList[21][21];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 20; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 20; ++j) {
                ns[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                np[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        int rx = 0, ry = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (s[i][j] == 'Z' || s[i][j] == 'Y') {
                    sc[i][j] = -1;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (s[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    rx = i;
                    ry = j;
                    ir[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(s[i][j])) {
                    sc[i][j] = s[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int k = 0; k < sc[i][j]; ++k)
                        ns[i][j].add(sp++);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(p[i][j])) {
                    pc[i][j] = p[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int k = 0; k < pc[i][j]; ++k)
                        np[i][j].add(pp++);
                }
            }
        }
        // BFS from zombie start
        Deque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        q.addLast(new int[]{rx, ry});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.pollFirst();
            rx = cur[0];
            ry = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = rx + dx[d];
                int ny = ry + dy[d];
                if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n && sc[nx][ny] != -1 && ir[nx][ny] > ir[rx][ry] + 1) {
                    ir[nx][ny] = ir[rx][ry] + 1;
                q.addLast(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        // initialize dd
        dd = new int[21][21];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                if (sc[i][j] > 0)
                    wk(i, j);
        int result = kuhn();
        System.out.print(result);
    }
}
